# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — Run Config Drift Detector

```html
<h2>Run Config Drift Detector — Eliminate "Works on My Machine"</h2>

<p>
  Run Config Drift Detector compares your IDE run configurations against a
  <code>.run-requirements.yaml</code> manifest, catching JDK mismatches, missing
  environment variables, and incorrect settings before they cause mysterious failures.
</p>

<h3>Environment Validation</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>JDK Validation</b> — Verify JDK version and vendor match project requirements</li>
  <li><b>Environment Variable Checks</b> — Ensure required env vars are present with correct values</li>
  <li><b>Working Directory Validation</b> — Confirm paths resolve correctly</li>
  <li><b>Port Conflict Detection</b> — Detect ports already in use before running your application</li>
</ul>

<h3>Drift Reporting</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Health Check Dashboard</b> — Visual drift report with pass, fail, and warning indicators</li>
  <li><b>Quick-Fix Suggestions</b> — One-click corrections for every detected drift issue</li>
  <li><b>Auto-Scan on Startup</b> — Automatic validation when the project opens</li>
  <li><b>Manual Re-Scan</b> — Trigger a scan anytime from the Tools menu</li>
</ul>

<h3>Team Features (Pro/Team)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Auto-Generate Manifest</b> — Create .run-requirements.yaml from existing run configurations</li>
  <li><b>Team Config Sync</b> — Share and synchronize run configurations across your team</li>
  <li><b>Onboarding Mode</b> — Guide new team members through environment setup</li>
  <li><b>Common Issues Dashboard</b> — See the most frequent drift issues across the team</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free</b> — Full drift detection (up to 10 requirements), health reports, quick fixes</li>
  <li><b>Pro ($2.90/month or $29/year)</b> — Unlimited requirements, auto-generate manifest, onboarding mode</li>
  <li><b>Team ($5.90/user/month)</b> — All Pro features + team sync, common issues dashboard, .env.example sync</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, or compatible JetBrains IDE (2024.1+)</li>
  <li>A <code>.run-requirements.yaml</code> file in your project root</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Issues: <a href="https://github.com/jakubjirak">GitHub</a></li>
  <li>Email: jakub@jirak.dev</li>
</ul>
```
